title.zh: 使用场景：为什么要多加一层

subtitle.zh: 当光刻胶撑不完整段刻蚀时，需要Hard Mask接力
subtitle.en: When photoresist cannot survive the full etch, a Hard Mask takes over

body.zh: 是否使用Hard Mask取决于图形转移预算，；不是制程越先进就一定越复杂。
body.en: Whether to use a Hard Mask depends on the pattern-transfer budget,; not on an assumption that a more advanced process must be more complex.

body.zh: ① 薄PR成像
body.en: ① Thin-PR imaging

body.zh: 开始；Target Etch
body.en: Begin; Target Etch

body.zh: PR逐渐变薄；/顶部圆化
body.en: PR becomes thinner; / its top rounds

body.zh: ④ PR提前；耗尽
body.en: ④ PR is prematurely; exhausted

body.zh: ⑤ Target未刻完；或CD失控
body.en: ⑤ Target is not fully etched; or CD loses control

body.zh: 风险：PR选择比与刻蚀寿命不足，导致图形转移失败或不稳定。
body.en: Risk: insufficient PR selectivity and etch lifetime cause failed or unstable pattern transfer.

body.zh: ① 薄PR成像
body.en: ① Thin-PR imaging

body.zh: HM Open
body.en: HM Open

body.zh: PR被消耗；或去除
body.en: PR is consumed; or removed

body.zh: ④ Hard Mask保护 → ⑤ 完成深刻蚀并保持Profile。
body.en: ④ Hard Mask protects → ⑤ Deep etch is completed while maintaining the profile.

body.zh: 优势：Hard Mask相对更耐刻蚀，延长图形转移预算，；保护侧壁与维持关键尺寸。
body.en: Benefit: the Hard Mask is relatively more etch-resistant, extending the pattern-transfer budget,; protecting sidewalls and maintaining critical dimensions.

body.zh: Thin Resist；薄胶有利于分辨率，；但刻蚀寿命有限
body.en: Thin Resist; Thin resist benefits resolution,; but its etch lifetime is limited

body.zh: High Aspect Ratio；深槽、深孔与高台阶；刻蚀时间长
body.en: High Aspect Ratio; Deep trenches, deep holes and tall steps; Long etch time

body.zh: Difficult Target Etch；目标层厚或刻蚀化学；对PR选择比不足
body.en: Difficult Target Etch; A thick target layer or etch chemistry; with insufficient selectivity to PR

body.zh: Multiple / Self-Aligned；Patterning；需要中间Mask继续完成；图形倍增或转移
body.en: Multiple / Self-Aligned; Patterning; An intermediate mask is needed to complete; pattern multiplication or transfer

body.zh: 评估Target；深度与材料
body.en: Assess Target; depth and material

body.zh: 估算PR消耗
body.en: Estimate PR consumption

body.zh: 检查CD/；Profile风险
body.en: Check CD /; Profile risks

body.zh: 选择HM材料与；厚度预算
body.en: Choose HM material and; thickness budget

body.zh: 验证HM Open和；Target Etch窗口
body.en: Validate HM Open and; Target Etch windows

body.zh: Mask消耗预算；Target深度/厚度；最小CD；结构Aspect Ratio
body.en: Mask-consumption budget; Target depth / thickness; Minimum CD; Structure aspect ratio

body.zh: 加厚PR：刻蚀寿命可能增加；但曝光景深、分辨率和胶形貌；可能变差
body.en: Thicker PR: may increase etch lifetime,; but exposure depth of focus, resolution and resist profile; may deteriorate

body.zh: 使用HM：增加步骤与成本，；但改善深刻蚀保护，提升图形；转移的稳定性。
body.en: Using an HM: adds steps and cost,; but improves deep-etch protection and; pattern-transfer stability.

body.zh: PR提前耗尽；顶部圆化 / Faceting；CD扩大；图形倒塌；Target未刻完
body.en: Premature PR exhaustion; Top rounding / Faceting; CD enlargement; Pattern collapse; Incomplete Target etch

body.zh: PR初始/剩余厚度；HM剩余量；Litho/HM/Target CD；Cross-section Profile；决定是否需要HM；或调整Stack
body.en: Initial / remaining PR thickness; Remaining HM; Litho / HM / Target CD; Cross-section Profile; Decide whether an HM is needed; or adjust the Stack

body.zh: 简单浅刻蚀在PR选择比与Profile窗口足够时，可能不需要独立Hard Mask。
body.en: A simple shallow etch may not require a separate Hard Mask when PR selectivity and the Profile window are sufficient.
